title: Awesome Unexpected Inputs
title_zh: Awesome Unexpected Inputs · 键鼠之外的交互方式
tagline: Make a move. Make something happen.
tagline_zh: 一个动作，打开一种新的交互方式。
description: An illustrated collection of ways to control computers with voice, gaze, movement, breath and everyday objects. Each project connects a human input to a concrete action.
description_zh: 探索语音、视线、动作、呼吸与日常物件如何控制电脑。每个项目都说明：你做什么、什么检测它、最后能完成什么。

categories.name: Voice and sound
categories.description: Speech, commands and non-speech sounds mapped to computer actions.
categories.description_zh: 把语音指令和非语言声音映射为电脑操作。

categories.name: Eyes and face
categories.description: Eye tracking and facial movement for typing, selection, games and music.
categories.description_zh: 用眼动与面部动作进行输入、选择、游戏和音乐创作。

categories.name: Head and body
categories.description: Move a pointer, look around a game world or shape sound through motion.
categories.description_zh: 用动作移动指针、改变游戏视角或创作声音。

categories.name: Hands in air
categories.description: Hand tracking becomes touchless control with the specified tracking hardware.
categories.description_zh: 配合指定追踪硬件，让手部动作变成非接触式控制。

categories.name: Objects and surfaces
categories.description: Paper, markers and conductive materials become program interfaces.
categories.description_zh: 让纸张、标记和导电材料成为程序界面。

categories.name: Tilt and motion
categories.description: Gyroscopes, phones and small boards produce aiming, pointing and musical control.
categories.description_zh: 用陀螺仪、手机和小型开发板进行瞄准、指针和音乐控制。

categories.name: Breath and switches
categories.description: Purpose-built interfaces map sip/puff, switches and compact movements to input.
categories.description_zh: 用专用接口，把吹吸、开关和小幅动作转成输入。
